framePicker.hint: Find a moment where the court lines are clear (no players blocking them).

annotationTool.outOfFrameTip: The point is outside the frame — define the corner by tracing two visible lines
annotationTool.hint: Click to place · Drag an existing point to move it · Min. 4 points to compute H

annotationCanvas.phase0: Click on the first visible line (e.g. the side line)
annotationCanvas.phase1: Click on another point of the same line
annotationCanvas.phase2: First line set · Click on the second visible line (e.g. the baseline)
annotationCanvas.phase3: Click on a second point of that line to compute the corner
annotationCanvas.parallelWarning: ⚠ Nearly parallel lines — the corner may be imprecise

validationView.overlayHint: Green lines are the court projection from H. They should align with the real court lines in the video.
validationView.feedbackExcellent: Calibration suitable for zone and speed analysis.
validationView.feedbackPoor: High error. Go back and mark the points more precisely.
